bubbles.note: Omarchy installs with full-disk encryption, and the passphrase prompt at boot has no touch input. On a slate with no keyboard this is the first wall, before any tablet plugin runs.
Upstream Omarchy's screensaver ignores touch: only a key press inside its terminal dismisses it. Open as omacom/omarchy issue 7762; a fix is proposed in PR 7528.
Omarchy's menu takes exclusive keyboard focus, so a tap on any on-screen keyboard closes it. Open upstream as issue 9029; Ragtop and Gimbal work around it by cloning the overlays.

The Omarchy Archive (omarchyarchive.com, github.com/jstamb/omarchy-archive) indexes 8,073 community records with device and form-factor fields; 92 of its posts concern tablets or touch. Its data is public JSON and is the fastest way to find who has already run Omarchy on a given model.

Eighteen tablet, keyboard, rotation and touch plugins are listed in Omarchy's marketplace as of 2026-10-23, added between 2026-08-29 and 2026-10-19. None is first-party: Omarchy itself ships no tablet mode.
